newsitem.title: USA: Hydron sees "nominal" earnings in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Hydron sees "nominal" earnings in Q1.

text.p: Hydron Technologies Inc said Monday that it expects a nominal profit in the first quarter of 1997, and sales just below last year's record first quarter. The company did say, however, that sales will be well above 1996 fourth quarter sales, despite the fact that first quarter was primarily HyTech's transition period for developing and proceeding with its own marketing program.
The company said it finished the first quarter with no short or long term debt, paying its ninth consecutive dividend, and with over $5 million in cash.

The company said it brought eleven new products to market in 1996 and expects to launch several more throughout the balance of 1997. In the second quarter the company said it expects to launch its new vitamin and nutritional supplements, announced earlier this month.
Hydron develops a broad range of personal care products, including skin care, hair care, bath and body, and topical over-the-counter pharmaceutical products.
